  pdf_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(File.read!("../../test_documents/text/plain.txt"))
  result = Xberg.pdf_page_count(pdf_bytes)
rescue
  error -> IO.puts(:stderr, "#{inspect(error.__struct__)}: #{Exception.message(error)}")
